# Labs · John Jayasankar

> Independent products John Jayasankar shipped: RideLens, Daylight, RailDrop, Gridiron, AgentFit, Cartonry, KeepFloor, and Pricing Hub.

One page of static HTML, readable without JavaScript. Each build below links to
the live product; the case studies live on the portfolio.

## Builds

- [RideLens](https://ride-lens2.vercel.app/): Every ride, one comparison.
- [Daylight](https://daylight-app-wine.vercel.app/): Your screen, through the day.
- [RailDrop](https://rail-drop3.vercel.app/): Know when your train gets cheaper.
- [Gridiron](https://gridiron-pink-chi.vercel.app/): Every game. Every drive. One view.
- [AgentFit](https://agent-fit2.vercel.app/): When should a workflow get an agent?
- [Cartonry](https://cartonry.vercel.app/): Packaging dielines: cut, crease, fold, cost.
- [KeepFloor](https://keep-floor.vercel.app/): The Etsy list price that still pays you.
- [Pricing Hub](https://pricing-hub-seven.vercel.app/): Contractor job costing, estimate to invoice.
